content:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened a tiny PR to clean up gemspec warnings and add a retry-parity spec for the Ruby SDK. CI is failing in the Bundler 2.3 matrix though. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412

sam: Can you paste the CI snippet? I can try to repro locally with bundler 2.3.4

maya: Repro steps I used: rvm 3.2.2, bundle _2.3.4_ install -> `bundle install` shows the warning and then the spec job times out. Locally the retry spec passes. Minimal patch in the PR is just a gemspec metadata fix + a unit test.

jorge: I glanced at the retry spec — looks like it assumes an exact timing that's flaky on CI. Suggest stubbing the network and asserting call counts instead of real sleeps. Also we should assert backoff factor presence not absolute delays.

sam: CI log shows a different failure in another job: `Gem::LoadError: incompatible ffi (~> 1.15) for platform x86_64-linux` — bundler matrix picks up older system gems on some runners.

lee: I can try a quick patch: bump the dev dependency and loosen the ffi constraint in the gemspec, plus update the changelog. Will push to the branch.

release-bot: CI: ruby-sdk (bundle-2.3) failed — https://ci.internal/redwood/ruby-sdk/789/logs

maya: One more ask — the sampleapp onboarding guide still references the old env var name `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Support flagged it yesterday when helping a customer. Can we update the README and quickstart script in the same patch?

jorge: I can make a tiny docs PR to update the sampleapp README and add a short example showing retry options and token refresh snippet. e.g.

```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV.fetch("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# example retry config
client.configure(retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: ->(n) { 0.5 * (2**(n - 1)) } })
```

sam: Heads-up I'm OOO tomorrow, will review the PR on Friday. @lee if you push changes feel free to ping me for a quick look on Fri.

maya: :thumbsup: assigning the PR to @lee for the quick patch. If CI goes green, let's cut a patch release.

lee: pushed commit fixing gemspec constraints and updated the sampleapp README; rerunning CI now.

release-bot: CI: ruby-sdk (bundle-2.3) success — build 790. Changelog: 0.14.2 -> 0.14.3; release candidate tagged.

maya: Nice work everyone — I'll update the onboarding ticket with the new README link and mark the support case as resolved. Thanks :tada:
